title: Conglíngkaishi Wuxian Jinhua
blurb: Use it all, break through limits. Innate wisdom, academic pinnacle. Multiple forms, transcending evolution. Reborn, starting from scratch, infinitely evolving.

title: The Devil Butler
blurb: As the Demon King, Yifan Zhuo uses his knowledge and power, collected over millennia, to defeat all foes, until the day he is betrayed. With his last breath, the demon king manages to reincarnate... but into the body of a puny young servant! To Yifan's dismay, the servant has a spirit bond with his mistress, Lady Luo. Yifan, now known as Fan, finds himself inexplicably drawn to Lady Luo and links his fate to her family. With Lady Luo at his side, will he regain his place as the Demon King?

title: Necromancer, the Ultimate Scourge!
blurb: In a world where magic and monsters exist, Lin Moyu has hit the age of acquiring his very own profession. While most would be lucky just to obtain a high-level combat class, Moyu becomes the ultrarare necromancer! Being the first and only one of his kind, he has no idea of the potential he possesses on his journey to level up and face great challenges. What new heights will Moyu achieve with his unique army of undead?

title: I Am The Fated Villain
blurb: A transmigrator awoke in the world of martial arts and became the villain named Gu Changge. His goal is to harvest the luck of those called "the Son of Fate" in order to become the strongest. With the Sons of Fate as his deranged enemies, he changes the destiny of being a villain.

title: All Hail The Sect Leader
blurb: All the members of my sect are abnormally strong. All my disciples turn out to be big shots, and I'll definitely become invincible in this world!

title: Lucky Me: I Secretly Cultivated for 1,000 Years
blurb: Reborn into a world of immortal cultivation, Han Jue found himself blessed with the Gacha System, able to re-roll for stats in cultivation and luck. To stay out of trouble, Han Jue cultivated on his own, and kept quiet about his special abilities. But when his sect faced destruction, he stepped up to defend it. A thousand years later, after many generations of cultivation, the immortals were planning to cleanse the mortal realm, and Han Jue was finally forced to act. That was when he discovered that even gods and immortals were not as powerful as he had imagined…

title: Martial Peak
blurb:
The peak of martial arts is solitary and lonely. It is an endless pursuit for unattainable heights as well. In order to surpass the limits of martial arts, growth and the will to survive in adverse situations is necessary.
One day, Yang Kai, a disciple-on-trial (and floor sweeper) of the Lingxiao Martial Arts Sect discovered a Wordless Black Book. That marked the turn in his luck and the beginning of his martial arts journey.

title: Rebirth Of The Ultimate Master
blurb:
What happens when a former martial emperor gets reborn into a complete loser's body? Gu Feiyang, a legendary martial artist who was ranked third-strongest in the continent, finds himself in this predicament when he wakes up in the body of 15-year-old Li Yunxiao. Li Yunxiao was once a failure who had yet to open a single chakra portal in his body, but now he's morphed into a genius martial artist overnight and becomes the talk (and target) of the town. Armed with the expertise of his former life, Li Yunxiao is on a mission to complete the ultimate incantation that killed him in the first place - all while wiping the floor with his former bullies at school. Will he be able to exceed the accomplishments of his previous life? One thing's for certain: no one will ever call him a loser again!




Note: The title of the manhua changed from 万古至尊 to 这一世我要当至尊 starting from Ch. 14.

title: Global Awakening: I Awakened Celestial Lightning
blurb: Raiden Xu transmigrated into a world where anyone could awaken their own unique ability, yet he awakened the weakest E-Rank ability. But just as everyone thought he was destined for mediocrity, the system awakened! E-Rank Low Voltage has been upgraded to the S-Rank Celestial Fulgur! Take down monsters, farm Ability Points, and embark on an endless journey of growth and evolution! Once its limits were transcended, Raiden came to realize the bolt in his grasp was now the SSS-Rank Bolt of Chaos that could decimate the world! From an unknown E-Rank to an unparalleled powerhouse, Raiden’s legend begins here!

title: Log Into The Future
blurb: 300 years after mutated beasts ravaged the world, humanity began to lose ground, with only martial arts as their last line of defense. Lu Sheng mysteriously gains the power to journey 10,000 years into the future, only to find humanity has disappeared. However, he acquires the culminated martial arts wisdom to fight back against these monsters, honing his skills to the pinnacle. Armed with this new-found knowledge, can Lu Sheng emerge as the final beacon of hope for humanity's survival?

title: God-Tier Assassin: I Am the Shadow
blurb: The mysterious game God’s Forsaken has descended upon Earth. In this world, players can gain lifespan by slaying monsters—and even better, they can expend that lifespan to manifest their in-game powers into reality! As supernatural abilities awaken, global chaos and disasters follow in their wake. In his previous life, Qin Feng fought tooth and nail to protect his sister, Qin Xiaoyou, eventually rising to become one of the top 100 powerhouses in the world. However, his devotion was met with the ultimate betrayal. Blinded by her obsession with a celebrity idol, his own sister gouged out his eyes to steal his "Ancient God’s Eyeballs" as a gift for her star. Now, reborn and sent back to the very beginning, Qin Feng has returned. This time, he will trust no one. Embracing the darkness, he chooses to walk the path of a god-tier assassin to become the strongest—alone!

title: Transmigrated as an Omega Who Snags His Alpha
blurb: Quinton Lewis was once a ruthless mafia boss until a fatal gunshot ended his life. When he reopens his eyes, he wakes up in a stranger's bed, dressed in lingerie. Acting on instinct, Quinton attempts to attack the stranger only to uncover a shocking truth: he's transmigrated into an omegaverse world as a pampered Omega and the stranger turns out to be his supposed Alpha lover, Cain Lloyd. Trapped in a body and role he never chose, Quinton must navigate power, desire, and danger once again.

title: All-Class Awakening: God Slayer
blurb: Elias Bai, Captain of God's Legion, stood as the world's strongest Awakener until a brutal betrayal claimed his entire squad. Dying as a mere pawn of the ruling elite, he suddenly wakes up twenty years in the past—back in middle school, long before his awakening. With his loved ones still alive, Elias refuses to let history repeat itself. To save his team, exact vengeance on the traitor, and overthrow the corrupt system, he must walk a lonely road to unrivaled power.

title: My Disciples Are All Villains
blurb:
When Lu Zhou wakes up one morning, he finds himself in a rather prickly situation. He has become the most powerful and the oldest villain in the world. He has nine disciples, each of whom has a full record of misdeeds. His first disciple is the head of the Nether Sect, served by thousands of followers. Known as the Sword Demon, his second disciple kills anyone who displeases him. Having lost his powers, how is he going to discipline his wicked disciples?
“I make a clean sweep of all obstacles wherever I go. Nobody can walk all over me except my master,”
says Yu Zhenghai, his first disciple.
“I can’t rest easy until my master is dead,”
says Si Wuya, his seventh disciple.

title: Starting Over as a Tree
blurb: One minute, he was choking on water, and the next, he found himself in a canyon and turned into a willow tree! Before he could reconcile with this new sad reality, the world decided to throw him another curveball. With the return of spirit energy, every living thing started to mutate, and his life was soon turned into a game of survival. Luckily, he was gifted with the ability of infinite evolution. But was it really a blessing? Or was it also a curse in disguise?

title: From Simp to Billionaire: The Rise of a Divine Tycoon
blurb: Lin Xinben was just your ordinary simp. After getting dumped, he received the Shenhao System, which gave him billions to spend right away! But the painful part is that he must spend that money on girls! Oh well, in order to put the money use, Lin Xin will embark on a strange journey of revenge, by becoming a godly playboy!

title: Shut up, Evil Dragon, I Don't Want to Raise A Child with You Anymore
blurb:
The dragon slayer Leon was defeated and captured by the Silver Dragon Queen. With his life on the line, he tried to use forbidden magic to curse the dragon queen, but the curse had unexpected side effects, and the queen lost control as they had a one-night stand.
He thought that the shame she would carry for the rest of her life would be enough to fulfill his life's purpose as a dragon slayer.
But two years later, when Leon opened his eyes, he found a young dragon girl with a tail sleeping next to him…

title: Myriad Realms Gatekeeper
blurb: When the planet perishes and the gods fall, the collapse of the magical realm leaves humanity without any protectors. Now, "Anomalies" and "Catastrophes" begin to invade the human realm . As the Dark Age descends, a soul from Blue Star (Earth) is unexpectedly transported into this dying realm.

title: The Glutton: Devourer of Kings
blurb: Humanity's world was destroyed by the Demon Kings. Stripped of everything, Awakener Ash Si sacrificed himself in a devastating explosion to drag Demon King Voralune, The Glutton, down to hell. Instead of death, he opens his eyes ten years in the past, long before the tragedy occurred. He discovers his powers have awakened early, and surprisingly, he also possesses Voralune’s power of Gluttony. Armed with this advantage, Ash decides to act in advance. With his return, everything in the world seems to be changing...

title: World's Best Martial Artist
blurb: Rebirth is just a starting point from reaching the peak. Intruding crypt, the rise of martial arts

title: Dang E Yi Yu Dao Bing Jiao
blurb: A yuri story about a yandere commoner × villainess lady. When the arrogant noblewoman He Sha tried to bully the commoner girl Qiao Lin out of jealousy, the yandere Qiao Lin turned the tables and took her first kiss instead. At first, He Sha just wanted to get back at Qiao Lin by playing pranks on her, but eventually it became an excuse to try to attract Qiao Lin's attention… The more the villainess tries to mess with the yandere, the more the yandere returns the favor, which only makes the villainess more tsundere.

title: Biancheng Ke Xi Chushou Guai Hou, Tamen Geng Fengkuangle!
blurb: For unknown reasons, Xiao Zheng would transform into a tentacle monster when he became excited. Even if he longed for love, he would disguise himself as being cold. But suddenly he was summoned by Bai Anan, who was usually serious but secretly loved drawing. He signed an agreement and became Bai Anan’s “familiar”. He was threatened to help her – to draw the Manhua that would top the list!

title: Mirrorfield: Overturning the World with a Reversal Skill
blurb: Fifty years after the fusion of the Game World and Reality, a top-tier warrior emerged. He dedicated his life to the world but was ultimately killed by the highest authority out of fear. Before his death, he awakened the SSS-Rank hidden skill [Mirror World] and sealed his soul beneath the surface of a lake. The King covered up the history and fabricated a new one; from then on, the warrior was known to the world as a traitor. Decades later, the warrior has awakened in the body of a dying man, using the [Mirror World] skill to begin his revenge.

title: Dumped... Then I Became a Martial God
blurb: What’s the first thing Rhys Valdez does after being reborn into the recent past, realizing he has a second chance to correct any past mistakes? He breaks up with his girlfriend, setting up for a romantic saga of star-crossed lovers... until, that is, a mysterious System awakens and reveals that Earth’s impending Spiritual Energy Revival is merely one short year away from triggering the apocalypse. With the knowledge of the past and power of the future, can Rhys ascend the Realms of Cultivation in time to save humanity?

title: My Virtual Immortal Path
blurb: How arduous the Immortal Path truly is! And even more so in a cultivation world utterly transformed by a devastating plague. Mortals carry the pestilence within their bodies and once immortals come into contact with it, the best outcome is a drop in cultivation while the worst would be a return of their Dao to Heaven itself. Thus, immortals and mortals are forever divided. I crossed into this world filled with boundless ambition, yet could only struggle and flounder in the mortal realm, wasting away an entire lifetime. Fortunately, at the moment of my death, I finally awakened an extraordinary treasure—one that could turn reality into illusions, transforming a genuine life into nothing more than a fleeting dream, and send me back to the very moment I first transmigrated into this world. And so, my long road to immortality began.

title: Gao Wu: Zhisou Heng Tui Sanqian Di!
Wo de Huashen Zhengzai Chengwei Zuizhong BOSS
blurb: After living an utterly ordinary life for over a decade, one night Ji Minghuan suddenly awakened a strange superpower—the ability to create game characters in the real world. Each character came with their own main storyline and a unique skill tree system. From that moment on, he was unstoppable. He kept creating new characters, developing their skill trees, and nurturing their systems… As long as a character’s popularity increased, their powers would grow stronger. So he started stirring up trouble like crazy, doing whatever it took to grab attention. He acted like a total sh*t-stirrer, bouncing back and forth between superheroes and supervillains alike. By the time he snapped out of it, Ji Minghuan was already sitting on the moon, staring down at the battered, bruised blue planet. A bunch of maxed-out characters stood silently behind him. With an innocent look on his face, he couldn’t help but mutter, “I swear I didn’t mean to destroy the world!”

title: Battle Through the Heavens
blurb: In a land where no magic is present and the strong make the rules, Xiao Yan, a gifted teenager, suddenly became useless and loses everything. As an enviable former genius, everyone bullied him after he lost his ability, even his fiancee demanded to divorce! However, things are changeable, with the help of master Yao Chen hidden in the ring left by his mother, Xiao Yan made a vow at age 15 to step up to the peak of the Dou-qi continent for the sake of his family and his loved people. A legendary reversal just begin!

title: Jianle Dongxi de Lang
blurb: A story about a wolf, his encounter with a small puppy, and their life together following.

title: Please Bully Me, Miss Villainess!
blurb:
Yifang found herself transported into the body of a villainess in an otome game. As the villainess Yvonne, she was supposed to be hated by the readers, as she bullies the FMC and helps the main characters come together. But there seems to be something wrong with this game's main character Elsa!

"Hey, I told you not to come so close!"

"Oh Yvonne… so how would you like to bully me today..."

title: The Devil Never Cries
blurb: In 3069, Earth faces annihilation from demonic invaders. Through grafting technology, humans turn the tide at the Battle of the Dawn by using demonic powers against their invaders. Amid this chaos, Aang, the Mightiest Warrior, falls, but his demise isn't the end. Instead, he mysteriously travels 60 years into the future, harboring the ultimate demon power within him—a double-edged sword. To overcome past regrets and uncover the truth, he must continuously "evolve" to control the demon within.

title: Dafeng's Night Squad
blurb:
In this world, there are Confucianists, Taoists, Buddhists, demons, and priests.
When Xu Qi'an, a police academy graduate, woke up from a coma, he found himself imprisoned, and he would be banished to the border in three days.
At first, he only wanted to save himself and be a rich guy who could live leisurely in a society without human rights…

Many years later, when Xu Qi'an looked back on his life, his enemies had died, and he had killed many people.
Time flew, and heroes passed away. Everything they did, whether good or bad, successful or not, was eventually swept off by time.
Yet the world remains unchanged, and the sun still rises and sets as usual.

title: Villain Cultivator’s Secret Return
blurb: A hundred years ago, Chu Xiu transmigrated to the Empyrean Continent and rose as a fearsome villain—only to be hunted down and destroyed. Reborn with his memories intact, he's done playing the glaringly obvious bad guy. This time, Chu Xiu will grow stronger in the shadows, posing as a righteous hero admired by all while secretly manipulating fate itself. With a gamelike system at his side and a new strategy in mind, he'll rewrite his doomed future. After all, the most dangerous villain is the one no one sees coming.

title: National Job Change: I'm Stuck As the Weakest Dragon Tamer?!
blurb: Luke Foster thought he was doomed when he awakened as a Dragon Tamer, the most useless hidden profession in existence. Dragons are so rare and powerful that for eight centuries, no Dragon Tamer has ever succeeded in taming a dragon. But without one, he can't even unlock his basic skills, leaving him powerless in a world ruled by fighters. Then everything changes after Luke activates the Super Treasure Map System. The mysterious system leads him to the ultimate prize: a real dragon egg! And so, this "weak" Dragon Tamer is about to flip the world upside down.

title: The SSS-Rank Paladin Who Breaks All Rules
blurb: The game has become reality. Monsters run wild, and every human gets one shot to awaken a class. When Victor Chase awakens, he pulls an S+ talent—"Blessing of the Holy Angel"—and unlocks a hidden class thought to be worthless: the Paladin! Weapon Blessing. Angelic Blessing. Blessing of Honor. One buff after another, his power skyrockets until even the air itself trembles. So... who said Paladins were trash-tier?

title: Goblin's Ascent: From Loser to Winner
blurb: After waking up in a goblin's body and getting brutally killed by humans, Jace Hurley triggers a life simulation game system. By continuously evolving, the blessed goblin crawls all the way up to become the world's strongest fighter. The Saint of Swords, the dragon mother Fryrmiel, angels, and goddesses have all succumbed to his charms.

title: Jue Chu Feng Sheng
blurb: The comet virus ravages the earth, and most of the world's humans are infected and become zombies. The remaining humans live in an underground city called the Shire. Xiao Yan, a rookie researcher, longs for a stable and lazy life. During a mission, he is saved by Hai Yin, a famous figure in the special mission force. Xiao Yan is deeply attracted to Hai Yin, and Hai Yin also begins to think about how to ensnare the rookie researcher...

title: The Evil Ring
blurb: Born in the ruthless Exile Land where his next meal was never guaranteed, Moon has always aspired to no longer be a worthless human stuck at the edges of society. And while a once in a lifetime opportunity may pay out enough money to let him live his dreams, his road to riches is paved with games of death and survival. Can Moon survive long enough to see better days?

title: Lord of Fate: When Mutation Strikes
blurb: Ever since the emergence of Phantom Star mutated plants and animals on earth into deadly monsters called beast gods, humanity has been on the brink of being wiped out. It was only when explorers who traveled to Phantom Star returned with formidable power that humans were able to start fighting back. Like countless others, Jiang Kai also traveled to Phantom Star in hopes of earning great strength. However, after overcoming brutal conditions and bloodthirsty monsters, he discovers that his profession is a gambler, a rare job that is not granted so easily.

title: Global Beast Tamer: I Can See Evolution Paths
blurb: After transmigrating into a new world, I end up with a tiny Snowball as my Pet Beast. Everyone laughs, calling it the weakest of the weak—an evolution dead end. A nobody with a useless companion… is that really my fate? Ding! The system activates. I can now see the hidden evolution paths of all Pet Beasts. Weak, you say? Watch closely how my little Snowball is about to evolve and awaken as the Ice Queen.

title: Online Game: Champion
blurb: Abnormality in his physical exam, a delay in cognitive function, missing memories, Lu Chen was enveloped by mysteries. Just as he was ready to return to the top after unlocking a special role, another twist of fate emerged...

title: I Became the Strongest Forbidden Mage
blurb: Lucian arrives in a world overrun with monsters as a Sorcerer. It's common knowledge that Sorcerers have short lifespans, because forbidden magic feeds on life force. But the truth is, Lucian can't die and his organs can regenerate, but nobody knows that. When he casts hundreds of forbidden spells at once, everyone is completely blown away!

title: Kaiju Zhuanzhi Caishen, Xunhua Yiwan Shen Chong!
blurb: The apocalypse game swept across the globe and merged with the real world, causing the collapse of order. In his previous life, Ye Xiao devoted everything to elevating his fiancée, Liu Ruyan, to the pinnacle of power, only to have his heart literally ripped out by her on the day of their engagement and transplanted into her male best friend. Reborn into a new life, Ye Xiao resolves to ascend the throne alone. Before the game closes its recharge portal, he spends billions of his fortune to switch to a god-level profession.

title: Wo Kaiju Shenhua Tianfu, Yi Jian Zhan Shen!
blurb:
Su Ming was once the world’s number one assassin, a hero who saved billions of his fellow humans and was honored as one of the Ten Great Powerhouses of the Dragon Nation. Yet, he was betrayed by the woman he loved and the brother he trusted, dying with hatred in his heart and buried within the S-class dungeon known as the Death Cavern.

Unexpectedly, he is reborn, returned to his high school days, on the very day of the awakening ceremony. This time, he gains a myth-grade talent upon awakening!

title: The Ravages of Time
blurb:
Nearly 2000 years ago, the prosperous Han dynasty of China collapsed. Heroes rose and fell, and three nations emerged--Wei, Shu, and Wu. Historians refer to this period as the Three Kingdoms period. The romance of the three kingdoms is an intriguing tale of heroic deeds, of alliance forged and broken, of loyalty and betrayal.
Hong Kong artist Chan Mou retells this classic tale in "The Ravages of Time" from the perspective of the Sima clan, which in the end united the three kingdoms. Readers will be attracted by an array of well-developed characters and Chan Mou's own unique top-notch art-style.

title: Tamen De Gushi
blurb: Sun Jing has a massive crush on a girl she sees at the bus station—feminine, blonde, and absolutely adorable, Qiu Tong is everything Sun Jing desires. But the tomboyish, outgoing Sun Jing cannot bring herself to utter a single word in Qiu Tong's presence. Once she musters up the courage, however, Sun Jing successfully introduces herself and secures a friendship with the cute girl. Although they are only friends for now, Sun Jing will do anything to see Qiu Tong smile; and with her genuine kindness, she might just win Qiu Tong's heart.

title: 19 Tian
blurb:
A group photo in kindergarten is the start of a lifetime friendship between Jian Yi and Zhan Zhengxi. They grew up together, and met good friends like He Tian and Mo Guanshan on campus.

"19 Days" not only shows the relaxed and happy school days of the four, but is also a story in which the boys come to understand each other and help each other grow up.

title: Tales of Demons and Gods
blurb: Because of the Space-Time Demon Spirit Book, time and space underwent a reversal. Though he was supposed to have died to demon beasts, Nie Li found himself sitting in a classroom when he opened his eyes. He had gone back to the age of thirteen. Now that everything has begun anew... how will he protect his beloved?

title: The Outcast
blurb:
The grave of Zhang Chunan's long-dead grandfather was desecrated by a group of mysterious people, but his grandfather's corpse wasn't the only thing they dug up. Secrets and mysteries surrounding the Zhang family began to surface, and Zhang Chunan is apparently more than just an ordinary college student desperate to be rid of his virginity.

One day, Zhang Chulan is attacked by zombies in a graveyard. In the midst of that situation, he saves the life of a girl, throwing the kitchen knife in his hand in order to kill the enemies. The girl tells Chulan, who is relieved, to face his hardships head on and leaves. However, Chulan later sees that girl again at his university. From that moment, Zhang Chulan's destiny begins to move. There will be strangers with special powers appearing one by one, with battles involving those abilities. Each episode will bring a new mystery to light.

First published under the title 异人 (Yi Ren, literally: "Weirdo") and with subtitle King of the Weirdo in February 2015. A collaboration Chinese/Japanese anime television series adaptation titled Hitori no Shita the outcast (一人之下 the outcast) aired in 2016.

title: Cheating Men Must Die
blurb: It's thrilling to torture the bad guys. If you keep torturing them, you'll get more fun. A story in which the herorine Su Lüxia and the supporting female character travel through tens of thousands of small worlds together to show countless bastards and bitches who are overwhelmed in various ways.
